result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0. For your example, WH-1 shows only "Bolt 10". `mvn -q -o test` passes. I didn't add a test for this case.

The change is in `findStockLevelsByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, and I updated its Javadoc to match.

The quantity lookup for a single product in a warehouse is a separate query, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 still answers 0. The stock list has only one caller, in `StockService`, so nothing else depended on the zero-quantity rows.
